directfs.description: runsc --directfs: the sandbox opens files through host file descriptors instead of the gofer round trip.

overlay2.description: runsc --overlay2: which mounts get the in-sandbox overlay. Both options keep writes in the sandbox own storage, so the disk cap still applies. (root:memory is not offered: it would move writes out of the disk cap.)

net_channels.description: runsc --num-network-channels: packet channels of the sandbox network stack.

log_driver.description: docker run --log-driver. The sandbox command is `sleep infinity`; customer output is read through exec, not logs.

prime.description: After an image is imported, read its layers once (docker save to /dev/null) so the first create does not pay for cold storage.

warm_size.description: Started, unclaimed deny_all sandboxes of the default shape kept ready for the most recently imported image, only while a customer holds the lease. They count against box capacity and are removed at hand-over.

refill_parallelism.description: How many replacement warm sandboxes may start at once after one is claimed.

idle_seconds.description: A warm sandbox unclaimed for this long is removed and replaced.

create_concurrency.description: How many sandbox creates one box runs at the same time. 1 is today's behaviour: creates one at a time.
